whyMatters.en: Trent Reznor's Cleveland studio project; The Downward Spiral (1994) brought sequenced aggression, distorted vocals, and machine-built dynamics to US rock mass media.
whyMatters.zh: Trent Reznor 的克利夫兰录音室项目；The Downward Spiral（1994）把音序攻击、失真人声与机器搭建的动态送进美国摇滚大众媒介。

shortBio.en: Reznor studio-as-instrument industrial rock; Closer and Hurt bracket the 1994 peak.
shortBio.zh: Reznor 录音室即乐器的工业摇滚；Closer 与 Hurt 框住 1994 高峰。

body.en:
Started Cleveland 1988 as a one-man studio band. Pretty Hate Machine and Broken EPs built the live/industrial hybrid; The Downward Spiral and The Fragile are dense peaks—sampling, ring-modulated vocals, programmed drums beside live kits.

Closer (1994) is the MTV/radio spike; Hurt documents the quiet side. NIN proves 1990s rock dynamics can be built from machines without exiting rock radio.
body.zh:
1988 年于克利夫兰以一人录音室乐队起步。Pretty Hate Machine 与 Broken EP 建立现场/工业混合；The Downward Spiral 与 The Fragile 是密集高峰——采样、环形调制人声、程序鼓与真人鼓组并存。

Closer（1994）是 MTV/电台尖峰；Hurt 记录安静面。NIN 证明 1990 年代摇滚动态可用机器搭建且不退出摇滚电台。

note.en: Pretty Hate Machine crossover; drum machines beside live kick on MTV.
note.zh: Pretty Hate Machine 跨界；鼓机与真人底鼓并列上 MTV。

note.en: Downward Spiral peak; programmed loop and live band hybrid on radio.
note.zh: Downward Spiral 高峰；程序 loop 与现场乐队混合打进电台。

note.en: Sparse piano and vocal; ballad template beside industrial singles.
note.zh: 稀疏钢琴与人声；工业单曲旁的谣曲模板。

title.zh: 工业音序登上摇滚电台

body.en:
Pretty Hate Machine (1989) crosses synth-pop hooks with drum-machine kick. The Downward Spiral (1994) densifies: layered noise, tape loops, Reznor's whisper-to-scream vocal.

Closer and Hurt share one album cycle—proof that machine-built tracks can sit on the same playlist as guitar bands.
body.zh:
Pretty Hate Machine（1989）把 synth-pop hook 与鼓机底鼓交叉。The Downward Spiral（1994）加厚：叠层噪声、磁带 loop、Reznor 耳语到嘶吼的人声。

Closer 与 Hurt 同属一专辑周期——证明机器搭建曲目可与吉他乐队同列播放列表。

title.zh: 一人录音室 vs 巡演乐队

body.en:
Reznor writes and records alone; live NIN expands to guitar, dual keys, bass, drums. Finck, Lohner, and Vrenna define the 1994–96 tour silhouette.

Atticus Ross joins production from With Teeth onward; Ilan Rubin holds the live drum chair post-2009. Catalog cites Reznor first; live roster is the second citation layer.
body.zh:
Reznor 独自写作录音；现场 NIN 扩成吉他、双键盘、贝斯、鼓。Finck、Lohner、Vrenna 定义 1994–96 巡演剪影。

Atticus Ross 自 With Teeth 起加入制作；Ilan Rubin 2009 后守现场鼓席。目录先引 Reznor；现场名单是第二层引用。

title.en: Studio aggression in alt-metal and electronic rock
title.zh: 录音室攻击进入 alt-metal 与电子摇滚

body.en:
Deftones and Radiohead cite the textural side—noise beds beside melody. Reznor's film-score work (Ross partnership) extends the studio-as-instrument method beyond NIN albums.

Influence is production grammar: distorted vocals, loop-based verses, and dynamic cuts that nu-metal and 2000s alt adopted wholesale.
body.zh:
Deftones 与 Radiohead 引用纹理面——旋律旁的噪声铺底。Reznor 电影配乐（与 Ross 合作）把录音室即乐器法延伸到 NIN 专辑之外。

影响是制作语法：失真人声、loop 主歌与动态切换，被 nu-metal 与 2000 年代 alt 整包采用。
